The 30 days is a time limit on a decision, not an end. Ends with the whole order: EO 13990 sec. 7(a) revokes the order, effective on signing, 2021-01-20. savings.reason: Reading record scale/readings/LSP-EO_13990.json (EO 13990, 86 FR 7037-7043, read once in full): sec. 7(a) revokes EO 13766 with no savings, pending-matter or transition clause; sec. 8(a) is only a general non-impairment clause for statutory agency authority and saves no revoked order; sec. 7(f) tells the OMB Director and agency heads to rescind issuances that implement or enforce the revoked orders; nothing is transferred. Own-residual check, reading EO 13766 in full: it creates no right, benefit, property or fund (sec. 4(d) disclaims rights) and no continuing duty beyond directions to the CEQ Chairman and agencies; the 'high priority' designations and deadlines contemplated by secs. 2-3 are determinations made under the order, and EO 13807 sec. 5(d), which redirected the CEQ functions, was revoked the same day by EO 13990 sec. 7(b). research_rationale: EO 13766 (signed 2017-01-24, 82 FR 8657-8658), read in full from the held FR text, has the CEQ Chairman decide whether a project is 'high priority' (sec. 2) and set expedited deadlines (sec. 3), plus general provisions (sec. 4). It has no term, sunset or termination clause; the machine own-term hits are only 'implemented consistent with applicable law and subject to the availability of appropriations' (sec. 4(a)), a condition on performance, not an end. EO 13990 (86 FR 7037-7043, read in full; reading record scale/readings/LSP-EO_13990.json) sec. 7(a) revokes it ('are hereby revoked') with no effective-date wording, so the revocation took effect on signing, 2021-01-20. The U.S. Code note to 42 U.S.C. 4370m says the same (revoked by EO 13990 sec. 7(a), 86 FR 7041); the note is corroboration only. Dossier lead 'target provision not located: EO:13807' resolved: EO 13807 (82 FR 40463, held FR text, read in full) does not revoke or amend the text of EO 13766; its sec. 5(d) implements EO 13766, widens the 'high priority' criteria and redirects the CEQ Chairman's secs. 2-3 responsibilities, so it is attached as a later event on secs. 2 and 3 (a partial change before the end). EO 13807 was revoked by EO 13990 sec. 7(b) the same day. A by-number scan of all 6,652 held FR-original texts finds EO 13766 named only in EO 13807 and EO 13990. EO 14148 and EO 14154 (2025) revoke EO 13990 but name none of the six orders in this batch and reinstate nothing, so no later instrument revives EO 13766. Inventory: the dossier's 10 clauses cover the operative text from the issuing words through sec. 4(d). Inventory correction: the dossier's lead clause 'I hereby direct as follows:' is only 27 characters, too short for the checker to verify, so inventory_overrides extend it backwards to the start of the issuing words ('By the authority vested in me as President ...'); all other spans are copied unchanged.
